# QuotaWatch

> Independent, dated and sourced tracker of AI coding plan prices and usage limits (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Gemini CLI). Every value links to a vendor page or official vendor X post, with an exact quote and check date. Last checked 2026-10-16.

## Data
- [Full dataset (JSON)](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/data.json): plans and changes, machine-readable
- [Changes RSS](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/feed.xml)

## Pages
- [All plans](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/): comparison table
- [Best plan finder](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/best-plan/)
- [Changelog](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/changes/)
- [Methodology](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/methodology/)
- [Claude (Anthropic)](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/tools/claude/)
- [GitHub Copilot](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/tools/copilot/)
- [Cursor](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/tools/cursor/)
- [OpenAI Codex](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/tools/codex/)
- [Windsurf](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/tools/windsurf/)
- [Gemini CLI](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/tools/gemini-cli/)
- [Grok / The X Subscription](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/tools/x-subscription/)

## Changes
- 2026-10-12 Cursor: [Cursor folds into The X Subscription: Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200; legacy Pro $20 / Pro+ $60 closed to new customers](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/changes/2026-10-12-cursor-joins-the-x-subscription/) (official)
- 2026-10-12 X Subscription: [The X Subscription launches: one plan across Grok, Cursor and X Premium (Free, Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200)](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/changes/2026-10-12-x-subscription-launch/) (official)
- 2026-09-29 Codex: [ChatGPT Pro adds $500 tier; Pro 200 reopens with lower allowance for new non-grandfathered subs](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/changes/2026-09-29-codex-chatgpt-pro-adds-500-tier-pro-200-reopens-with-low/) (official)
- 2026-09-14 Claude: [Claude Code weekly limits: permanent +25% vs pre-promo baseline, about 17% below the promo level](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/changes/2026-09-14-claude-claude-code-weekly-limits-settle-at-25-vs-pre-prom/) (official)
- 2026-06-18 Gemini CLI: [Gemini CLI replaced by Antigravity CLI for unpaid and Google One users](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/changes/2026-06-18-gemini-cli-gemini-cli-replaced-by-antigravity-cli-for-unpaid/) (official)
- 2026-06-01 Copilot: [Copilot moves to usage-based GitHub AI Credits; base prices unchanged](https://quotawatch.vercel.app/changes/2026-06-01-copilot-copilot-moves-to-usage-based-github-ai-credits-bas/) (official)
